Overview

PPC, explained

Pay-per-click advertising means you pay only when someone clicks. Different platforms suit different goals: Google for people ready to buy, LinkedIn for business buyers, YouTube for awareness, Shopping for products.

We choose the right mix of platforms for your goals, build and manage the campaigns, and track every click through to enquiries or sales.

Who it's for

  • B2B businesses targeting decision-makers
  • eCommerce stores selling products online
  • Businesses wanting to reach beyond Google and Meta
  • Businesses with clear sales goals and budgets

Why it matters

Why PPC matters for your business

Pay-per-click lets you reach people on the platforms they use most, paying only when they click. Each platform reaches people at a different moment: searching, researching, working or watching.

Running several platforms well takes expertise. Each has its own targeting, ad formats and bidding, and results need comparing fairly across all of them.

We choose the right platforms for your goals, run the campaigns, and report results together, so you know which channels are worth your budget.

Pricing

What affects the cost of PPC

  • How competitive your industry and keywords are
  • How many channels you want us to manage (search, ads, social, listings)
  • How much content and design you need each month
  • Your ad budget, which is always shown separately from our fee
  • Whether your website needs work before campaigns start

Every quote is itemised, in AUD or USD, and valid for 30 days.

FAQ

PPC questions

What's the difference between PPC and Google & Meta Ads?

PPC covers a wider range of platforms, including Microsoft, LinkedIn, YouTube and Shopping.

Do you charge a percentage of ad spend?

Our fee is quoted separately from ad spend, which is shown on its own line.

Which platform should we start with?

Usually wherever your customers are searching or browsing. We'll recommend a starting mix in your plan.

What's the minimum budget?

It depends on the platform and your market. We'll recommend a realistic starting budget in your quote.

Can PPC work alongside SEO?

Yes. Ads bring results quickly while SEO builds long-term rankings.

Is LinkedIn advertising worth it?

For B2B businesses targeting specific roles and industries, it can be very effective.

Do you run YouTube ads?

Yes, including short video ads for awareness.

How do you report results?

A monthly report shows spend, clicks, enquiries and cost per enquiry for each platform.
